seoTitle: Email Marketing ROI Calculator: Revenue per Campaign
metaDescription: Estimate revenue and ROI of an email campaign from list size, open, click and conversion rates, order value and cost. Free and private.
intro: Enter list size, the three rates, order value and cost to see projected revenue, net result and ROI.
why:
The chain from list to order has four steps and each loses most people. Writing it out shows what a change in one rate is worth: lifting clicks by a point may matter more than a long subject line debate.

The result is only as good as the rates you enter, so use figures from your own past sends. Add a margin to get profit instead of revenue. It does not model repeat purchases.
howTo: Enter open rate, click rate of opens and conversion rate of clicks.
Add order value, optional margin and the cost.
Read revenue, net result and ROI.

faq.q: Is click rate based on opens or sends?
faq.a: Here it is a share of opens (click-to-open). Convert if your tool reports clicks per delivered email.

faq.q: Should I add staff time to cost?
faq.a: Yes, otherwise ROI looks better than it is.
No, it is a calculation from your assumptions.
